newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Hundreds of Albanians block roads to south.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds of Albanians block roads to south.

text.p: Hundreds of Albanians blockaded a road and railway track in the town of Lushnje, south of Tirana, in apparent support for protesters in Vlore where some six people were killed overnight in a gun battle.

Reporters travelling to Tirana from the southern town of Vlore said hundreds of people in Lushnje, 80 km (50 miles) south of Tirana, were lined along and across the main road. The reporters said they had encountered four other roadblocks between Vlore and Lushnje.
The reporter said two army trucks were also on fire on the outskirts of Lushnje. Townsfolk said soldiers ran away when they saw their blockade, but the report could not be independently confirmed.
"People along the route have put tree trunks and parts of cars across the roads," one reporter told Reuters in Tirana by telephone.
Some vehicles were being allowed to pass once occupants were checked but at other points they had to make diversions along tracks to skirt the road blocks.
Roads were also blocked near the town of Gjirokaster, near the Greek border.
